items.text:
A great game if you a space ship as a submarine. Even though it is 2D, the game is game does a good job of simulating a good amount of realistic hazards of space.

Here is where some points of simulation stand (check dev road map for what is to come):
- Newtonian physics of ships and astral bodies, including gravity wells and orbital mechanics.
- Cold gas RCS thrusters only. Placement of thrusters relative to center of mass does not matter.
- Wiring does not simulate wattage.
- Realistic atmospherics for gas composition, pressure, and temperature.
- Medical conditions for low oxygen, low pressure, vacuum, or high carbon dioxide. Oxygen toxicity is missing though.
- Everything happens in real-time, although time acceleration can be used at will.
- Collisions with other ships shoves them around appropriately. Collision damage occurs, although it is rather forgiving. A blessing for those learning docking procedures.
- AI of NPC characters and ships is very rudimentary and prone to unusual behavior. Social needs and dialog are also rudimentary as far as what you can do with them, but the framework is there for it to become something much deeper.
- Combat is non-existent. Well, except for patrol vessels ramming your ship to push you into a collision course with other ships or asteroids.
- Economics is almost non-existent. There are a few merchants that have fluctuating inventories and pricing, but you have no way to track these things without physically talking to them every time.
- No ship-to-ship communication yet, other than requesting clearance for docking/pushback.
items.text_zh:
如果你把太空船当作潜艇来玩，这是一款很棒的游戏。尽管它是2D的，这款游戏很好地模拟了大量真实的太空危险。

以下是模拟的一些要点（查看开发者路线图了解未来内容）：
- 飞船和天体的牛顿物理学，包括引力井和轨道力学。
- 仅使用冷气RCS推进器。推进器相对于质心的位置无关紧要。
- 布线不模拟瓦数。
- 真实的大气环境，包括气体成分、压力和温度。
- 针对低氧、低压、真空或高二氧化碳的医疗状况。不过缺少氧中毒。
- 一切都实时发生，尽管可以随意使用时间加速。
- 与其他飞船的碰撞会适当地将它们推开。会发生碰撞损伤，尽管相当宽容。对学习对接程序的人来说是福气。
- NPC角色和飞船的AI非常初级，容易出现异常行为。社交需求和对话在你所能做的方面也很初级，但框架已经存在，可以发展成更深层的东西。
- 战斗不存在。嗯，除了巡逻船撞击你的飞船，把你推入与其他飞船或小行星的碰撞航线。
- 经济几乎不存在。有几个商人拥有波动的库存和定价，但除非每次亲自和他们交谈，你无法追踪这些东西。
- 还没有船对船通信，除了请求对接/推离许可。

observations.description: 没有船对船通信功能，除了请求停靠或许可。
